description: Generate North American road-trip itineraries as a map-first, offline-friendly single-file HTML page. Plans around daily driving segments, overnight stops, fuel/EV-charging, national-park reservations (Recreation.gov / NPS), seasonal road closures, and timezone/border crossings — for executable, decision-ready trips. Two entry modes: give a start + region/destination + days and it plans the whole route, or hand it an existing route and it verifies, fills gaps, and produces the page.
